```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 05_z_scores_scores_raw
title: >
  Describe the Scores
questions:
  - id: raw_scores
    type: free-response
    prompt: >
      You completed one test in 8 seconds and another in 70 seconds. Are the raw
      times enough to conclude which performance was better relative to other people?
    answer: >
      No. Completion times from different tests are not directly comparable without
      knowing the distribution of times for each test.
    explanation: >
      A score only has meaning relative to the distribution it came from.
```
